2026-09-03.english_html:
📖 30天趣味记忆·第1篇
第1篇：A young scholar, despite numerous setbacks, never abandoned his ambition. He believed that diligent effort, not innate talent, was the key to success. Each morning, he reviewed vocabulary, and each evening, he practiced writing. Gradually, his comprehension expanded, and his confidence soared. He realized that every obstacle was a stepping stone, and that perseverance would ultimately illuminate his path. 中文翻译：一位年轻学者，尽管屡遭挫折，从未放弃志向。他相信勤奋努力，而非天赋，是成功的关键。每天早晨他复习词汇，每晚练习写作。渐渐地，他的理解力扩展，信心高涨。他意识到每个障碍都是垫脚石，坚持终将照亮前路。 重点词汇：ambition, diligent, innate, comprehension, perseverance, obstacle, illuminate
✅ 每日自测
中译英：1. 这位学者从未放弃他的雄心。2. 勤奋努力是成功的关键。3. 每个障碍都是垫脚石。 英译中：1. He reviewed vocabulary each morning. 2. Her confidence soared gradually. 3. Perseverance will illuminate your path. 填空：1. Despite many ______, she kept her ambition. (setbacks) 2. He believed that ______ effort, not talent, mattered. (diligent)
